stage_prompts.grab_table: Grab the package on the table with right arm <color>.
stage_prompts.turn_to_scanner: Turn the waist right to face the barcode scanner.
stage_prompts.place_on_scanning_table: Place the package on the scanning table with the barcode facing up.
stage_prompts.grab_from_scanning_table: The right arm grabs the package.
stage_prompts.rotate_to_bin: Rotate the waist with the right arm.
stage_prompts.place_in_blue_bin: Place the package in the blue bin.
stage_prompts.return_initial: Both arms coordinate and the waist returns to the initial posture.
